comparison_to_pre_q5_profile.interpretation: The promoted Q5 route removes about half of its former kernel window. Other large families are clock-flat, so the direction agrees with the counterbalanced full-engine win. The higher launch count is the expected bounded tile chain and is not itself a regression signal.

remaining_exact_q4_role_census.method: The exact Q4 kernel has a 48-column output block. Grid X and immutable model inventory uniquely identify each output width; all rows use two 256-row Y blocks.
remaining_exact_q4_role_census.inventory_note: Exactly 24 of 48 linear-attention layers have Q4T16 attn_qkv; attn_gate is Q4T16 in all 48 layers. Those 24 same-input Q4/Q4 pairs are the next operation boundary.

next_lane.selected: exact unequal-output Q4T16 linear-attention attn_qkv plus attn_gate dual-WMMA prefill
next_lane.reason: The 24 same-input Q4/Q4 pairs account for every 28.600-ms Q4 attn_qkv call plus an inferred half of the identical-shape 38.532-ms gate family, a 47.866-ms / 8.74%-of-kernel measured-family ceiling. Unlike the rejected singleton gate source-F16 route, a dual exact owner is a new operation-complete dataflow: it can reuse each BF16 activation fragment while preserving two independent T16 decode/WMMA/BF16 publication boundaries, adds no resident layout or workspace, and directly targets the still-failing 512/1K gates.
next_lane.ceiling_note: The 47.866-ms ceiling assumes the 24 paired gate calls have the mean cost of the 48 identical-shape gate calls; it is an attribution estimate, not a speed claim.
next_lane.first_gate: Implement a temporary unequal-output exact dual Q4T16 leaf for actual Q4/Q4 attn_qkv+attn_gate pairs and compare its complete pair wall against two retained singletons at M512/1024/4096 on both gfx1100 boards. Preserve each output's existing K16 association and BF16 bits. Stop at the leaf if any required row loses; only then wire through linear_pair and run full-engine gates.
excluded_by_fresh_profile: The already rejected singleton Q4 linear-attention gate source-F16 route remains closed by its W7900 M512 confirmation.
The full-attention Q singleton is only 4.10% of kernel sum and its bounded source-F16 4K leaf already lost.
GDN remains only 7.49% of kernel sum and lacks a comparator gap; attention, casts, fills and copies remain lower priority.

decision: Use the fresh post-Q5 role census, not the obsolete pre-Q5 rank, to screen an exact unequal-output Q4T16 QKV+gate dual owner next. This diagnostic profile does not change production or claim profiler throughput.
